**q25** — Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the `filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go` (`NewEngine`/`Compile`), schema in `internal/filter/schema.go`, IR in `internal/filter/ir.go`, SQL emitter in `internal/filter/render.go`. Mechanism: the handler validates the filter (`server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:336` / `ListMemos` at `memo_service.go:211`), the string is stored on `store.FindMemo.Filters`, and each dialect driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect*, &where, &args)` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69` — which compiles CEL to a dialect-agnostic condition tree and renders dialect-specific SQL + placeholders (`?` vs `$n`) appended to the WHERE clause.

**q26**
```
memo          — the memo row itself, plus its comment memo rows (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:573-577; store/db/*/memo.go DeleteMemo)
memo_relation — rows where memo is source and where it is target (store/memo.go:142-147)
attachment    — rows linked to the memo (store/memo.go:148-157)
memo_share    — only via DB-level FK ON DELETE CASCADE (postgres/mysql LATEST.sql:108); NOT enforced on SQLite, which opens with _pragma=foreign_keys(0) (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53)
```
`reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but are **not** deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545-550`).

**q27** — Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is compiled into the binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:40-59` (`Serve`, static middleware + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); invoked from `server/server.go` via `NewFrontendService(...).Serve(...)`.

**q28**
```
s3presign.Runner — RunOnce immediately at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker
  (server/server.go:161-172; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
```
Also running, but not "runners" started by `Server.Start`: 4 webhook delivery goroutines drained from a bounded queue, started by package `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:41-54`); per-`Cache` cleanup goroutines with a `CleanupInterval` ticker created with the store (`store/cache/cache.go:199-201`, `store/store.go:51-53`); per-connection SSE heartbeat ticker (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:64`).

Unused infrastructure: **`internal/scheduler`** (full cron/job scheduler with parser, middleware, jobs) is imported only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `integration_test.go`) — nothing in the server uses it. Likewise `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:20`) is never instantiated by the server; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from handlers.

**q29**
```
interceptor — web/src/connect.ts:148 (authInterceptor), attached to the Connect transport at :174;
              token store/refresh helpers in web/src/auth-state.ts and web/src/hooks/useTokenRefreshOnFocus.ts
tokens — short-lived JWT access token (15 min) sent as "Authorization: Bearer", kept in memory/localStorage
         and cross-tab synced; long-lived refresh token in an httpOnly cookie "memos_refresh" (30 days),
         auto-refreshed proactively and on a 401 retry; server also accepts Personal Access Tokens ("memos_pat_" prefix)
backend package — server/auth (server/auth/authenticator.go, server/auth/token.go, extract.go),
                  driven by server/router/api/v1/authz.go (Authorizer) via NewAuthInterceptor / gateway middleware (v1.go:67-93,133-138)
```

**q30**
```
memo created:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called at memo_service.go:157)
memo updated:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called from dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects, memo_update_helpers.go:67 — used by UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations)
memo deleted:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called at memo_service.go:562)
memo comment created: APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called at memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
Created/updated/deleted all funnel through `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:181` / `:117`.
